crew.overview: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.
crew.title: Top Gun: Maverick

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

details.biography:
Courtney “Coco” Ullrich is a hairstylist based in Los Angeles. She has built a reputation as a personal hairstylist for actor Pedro Pascal.

Over the course of her career, Ullrich has held roles as key hairstylist, hair department head, and grooming specialist on various TV series and mini-series, including Supergirl, New Girl, Scream Queens, Shameless, Looking for Alaska, and Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life (2016). Her film credits include Top Gun: Maverick (2022) and The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent.

In recognition of her artistry, she was nominated for a Hollywood Makeup Artist & Hair Stylist Guild Award for Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life (2016) in the category Best Contemporary Hair Styling – Television Mini-Series or Motion Picture Made for Television (shared with Ange Bebbington). She was also nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 2023 for Outstanding Contemporary Hairstyling for The Last of Us (the episode “Long, Long Time”) (shared with Chris Harrison-Glimsdale and Penny Thompson).

Beyond her credits, Ullrich has discussed the technical and creative aspects of her work, such as her preparations for Pascal’s 2023 Oscars look, where she described using texture and mousse to sculpt polished curls.

She is represented by A-Frame Agency.
details.name: Courtney Ullrich
